title: Word Flash
desc: Study CS terms, hide them, and retrieve each word from its definition.
instructions: Study the terms at your own pace. When you are ready, hide the list and type the matching term for each definition. Capitalisation and surrounding spaces do not matter.

title: Flip & Recall
desc: Retrieve a definition before flipping each flashcard.
instructions: Read the term. Say or think its definition before you flip. Then honestly mark whether you recalled it. This is a self-assessed activity.

title: Sort & Remember
desc: Group CS concepts, then recall each concept’s category from memory.
instructions: Select a meaningful category for each term. Check your grouping, then hide it and recall the category for each term.

title: Code Breaker
desc: Chunk an operation sequence, then rebuild it in order.
instructions: Study the six operations as three meaningful chunks. Hide the sequence, then reconstruct different parts of the process in their original order.

title: Story Builder
desc: Create a vivid CS story and retrieve its original concepts.
instructions: Connect the selected concepts in a short story. Explain their roles, hide your story, then recall the original terms. Your story helps memory; it does not change the technical definitions.

title: Link the Concepts
desc: Match familiar analogies, then retrieve the concepts.
instructions: Match each concept to a familiar analogy. Check the links, then hide them and retrieve the concept from each analogy.

title: Memory Comeback
desc: Return to earlier concepts, with missed words first.
instructions: Retrieve concepts from your earlier practice. Missed concepts come first. Clearly labelled sample history is used when you have no earlier attempts. Reviews are scheduled from your results.

title: Rescue Forgotten Words
desc: Retrieve lost concepts and give difficult words another try.
instructions: Type the concept for each clue. A successful retrieval rescues it. Missed concepts get feedback and return once at the end for another chance.

title: Teach the Robot
desc: Explain CS concepts to a friendly robot and find the gaps.
instructions: Write explanations in your own words. A simple, predefined checklist highlights key ideas included and missing. This is rule-based feedback, not an AI assessment.

title: Knowledge Detective
desc: Use what you remember to solve practical CS scenarios.
instructions: Read each scenario and select the best answer. After each choice, see the technical reason and connect it to the memory technique you practised.
